summary: arista.eos deprecates automatic Jinja2 templating of eos_config's src parameter (removed March 2028); use content with the template lookup.
questions: How do I push a templated config with eos_config now?

answer_card.title: eos_config src templating deprecated
answer_card.answer_md:
Automatic Jinja2 processing of the `src` parameter in `eos_config` is deprecated and will be removed in **March 2028**. Use `content` with the template lookup:

```yaml
- arista.eos.eos_config:
    content: "{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.template', 'config.j2') }}"
```
